cause: User report: rain radar is unintelligible on E-ink. The shipping path converts the LCD frame with a single luminance threshold (eink::from_lcd); host measurements on 2026-11-07 show heavy-rain colours (yellow, orange) vanish and the intensity order is destroyed (disc darkness 0.00/0.00/0.99/0.98/0.00/0.00/1.00/0.78, weakest to strongest).
deliverables: Revised plugin requirements in docs/requirements/plugins/rain-radar.md fixing the E-ink rendering method
Matching AC-04 wording adjustment proposal for docs/requirements/README.md (design stage)
Design and implementation of radar eink_frame_for: native 250x122 semantic grayscale, pic2gray4px cell conversion, solid text overlay, existing mono1 wire format
Automated intensity-monotonicity golden test on the saved JMA sample; LCD frames byte-identical
Host inspection on a rain-heavy generation and user confirmation on a physical E-ink panel
dependencies: Parent (user) review and commit of the specification before implementation, per docs/development-process.md
Installed pic2gray4px CLI on the server (already established by the local-image and E-ink video work)
A rain-heavy JMA generation or fixture for pre-device host verification
escape_cause: The plugin requirements permitted uniform solid black and left the E-ink drawing method undecided (U-10/U-14), and acceptance so far used saved-sample host tests without an intensity-order check; the saved sample days are nearly rain-free (about 0.5 percent wet pixels).
introduction_cause: Radar never implemented ContentPlugin::eink_frame_for, so the generic LCD-to-E-ink threshold fallback designed for simple frames was applied to a colour-coded data map whose meaning is not carried by luminance.
title: Rain radar E-ink: semantic intensity-to-density rendering (method E)
